Mina sees through her in episode 6, and in episode 10 Tandy exposes Roxxon (she turns on it), so she ends up Independent again. Proposed: add the Roxxon stage, then Independent (see the companion left entry).

Left entry for the change above: Tandy's Roxxon internship ends when Mina finds her out (Cloak & Dagger S1 episode 6), and in episode 10 she exposes Roxxon (she turns on it). After that she is in no group. Same format as Delgado's record.

Past forced service, told on screen: in Captain America: The First Avenger, Erskine tells Steve that Hitler sent Johann Schmidt, head of HYDRA (the Nazi research division), to get him, and that he worked on the formula under Schmidt until Schmidt took an early version of the serum. He then fled to the U.S. and joined the SSR. Forced service counts, and a past group goes first, keyed to his first title.

owner_calls.question: Liam works as the bouncer at the nightclub where he and Tandy pick out their marks (Cloak & Dagger episode 1). The club isn't named for him on screen and it's a minor job. Should it be a group?
options: Add the nightclub as his employer
owner_calls.evidence: MCU Wiki: 'Liam Walsh worked as a vigil for a nightclub when he first met Tandy Bowen'. Episode 1 shows him guarding the club door.

owner_calls.question: In the Framework (Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4), Coulson is a history teacher at Alexander Pierce High School before he joins the Resistance. The Resistance is already recorded. Does a job inside the Framework count as an employer stage too?
options: Add Alexander Pierce High School (S4) before Framework's Resistance
owner_calls.evidence: MCU Wiki, 'Just a Teacher': in the Framework, Coulson turned down S.H.I.E.L.D. and became a history teacher. He leaves Alexander Pierce High School when Hydra moves to arrest him (S4 episodes 16-17).
